title: Ingredient and grower cards

location.extent: Complete local video; PNG is first-frame poster

slide_intent: Pair appetizing product imagery with origin information so viewers can connect appearance to provenance.
strategic_value: Named growers and places can make Sweetgreen’s sourcing story more specific.
demonstration: A sequence of carrot, kale, strawberry and red onion cards pairs large isolated photographs with colored ingredient headings and grower/location labels.
practical_value: Keep a repeatable hierarchy for ingredient, image, grower and location when presenting a varied supply story.

content_islands.name: Ingredient name and image
content_islands.spec: Use a large colored heading above the isolated ingredient photograph.

content_islands.name: Origin labels
content_islands.spec: Place grower at lower left and outlined location label at lower right; update both with the subject.

reference_purposes.Application: The sequence applies one card structure to four ingredients and their growers.
reference_purposes.Expression: Heading colors respond to the ingredient photographs while the cream ground stays consistent.
